responsibility: Generates the derived option-table file csky_tables.opt from the canonical definitions in csky_cores.def. The script emits GCC Enum and EnumValue records for C-SKY CPUs, architectures, and FPUs used by -mcpu=, -march=, and -mfpu= option parsing, so this file is the build-time bridge between the backend’s architecture/core catalogs and GCC’s generated option metadata.
